summary: Completed testing iteration 2 focusing on brand dashboard access fix and core functionality. Backend APIs working well (82.4% success rate), homepage and public pages functioning correctly. However, found critical frontend authentication issues preventing access to protected routes like admin and brand dashboards.

minor_issues.issue: Returns 403 instead of expected 401 for unauthorized access
Returns 400 instead of expected 401 for unauthorized access
minor_issues.impact: Minor - likely due to existing application

critical_bugs.issue: Frontend login appears successful (user name shows in header) but protected routes redirect back to login page
critical_bugs.impact: Blocks access to admin dashboard and brand dashboard

critical_bugs.issue: Cannot access /brand/dashboard - redirects to login despite successful authentication
critical_bugs.impact: Demo brand cannot access their dashboard to manage products

critical_bugs.issue: Cannot access /admin - redirects to login despite successful authentication
critical_bugs.impact: Admin cannot access dashboard to manage applications and brands

ui_bugs.issue: Shows loading spinner indefinitely when accessing brand profile

passed_tests: Homepage loads with 'Unveiled Threads' branding correctly
Marquee shows indie keywords (INDEPENDENT, UK MADE, SMALL BATCH, etc.)
Brand of the Week shows 'Thread & Bone' correctly
Products page loads with 3 Thread & Bone products
Category filtering interface present on products page
Brands page loads and shows Thread & Bone
Login form accepts credentials and shows user name in header
Backend API /api/brands/my-application works correctly for demo brand
Backend API returns Thread & Bone profile with 3 products
All public pages and navigation working correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix frontend authentication integration - while backend APIs work correctly, the frontend authentication context/routing is not properly handling authenticated users. Users can login (name appears in header) but cannot access protected routes like /admin or /brand/dashboard as they redirect back to login page. This suggests an issue with JWT token storage, cookie handling, or authentication context in React.
